items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: We were living with Jimmy Mundy and his wife... Jimmy was arranging for Paul Whiteman.

ctx.x: We'd sit by ourselves both of us and cried every day, wanted to come back to New York. We were living with Jimmy Mundy and his wife and they had two great big Chow dogs and I was afraid they were going to kill Barney. Before we'd go out or something they say they'd put their dogs out in the yard and bring Barney in the house.

But any time we'd be out I'd was worried to death that those dogs were going to get in the house. Because they hated Barney, another dog you know. And we had a chance to get a little apartment, it was during the war and there was a couple who lived around the corner from the Mundy's who had a nice little house. It was a duplex, two family and her husband had been drafted and she joined the WACS. And she was lonesome without him and she wanted in the WACS.

And the only way we could get the house right away was to let her stay in the house until the WACS called her you know, called for her to go into the WACS. And so, and if she was in there or not I wanted to get out of there with my dog. Because we went to d Paul Whiteman broadcast one evening because Jimmy was arranging for Paul Whiteman.
